notes: PrefLib file 00001-00000002.soi (dataset 00001, 'irish'). Counting rule, as far as we know: Irish STV (Dail), multi-winner.
party_source: Party abbreviations in PrefLib's candidate names (as printed on the ballot paper), checked candidate by candidate against the 2002 results on Wikipedia's constituency pages (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dublin_West_(Dáil_constituency)). 'Non-P' (non-party) candidates are null.

label_sources.date: Polling day of the 2002 Irish general election (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2002_Irish_general_election).
label_sources.max_ranks: Irish STV lets voters rank every candidate.
